meta.title: KaGawa — Book home help on demand
meta.description: Like Grab, but for home workers. Book plumbers, cleaners, electricians, and more — hourly, not live-in.

landing.heroAlt: KaGawa home service workers ready at the door
landing.headline: Instant help for your home — book, fix, pay.
landing.sub: Like Grab, but for plumbers, cleaners, electricians, and more. Hourly rates — not live-in.
landing.howBody: No card required — cash on completion + Bayad Code. Simple, masa-friendly booking.
landing.signalBody: When a worker is online in your area with a matching skill, the job appears in their feed — with a ping.
landing.payBody: When work starts, the customer gets a 4-digit code. Share it only after you're happy and have paid — protection for both.
landing.earnBody: Labor cash stays between customer and worker — 100%. KaGawa earns outside the job (Priority for workers, partners, B2B).
landing.servicesSub: Not just cleaning and repairs — the whole home, on demand.

terms.title: KaGawa Rules
terms.headline: Short rules. Read once.
terms.sub: Written so you finish in under 2 minutes. Breaking these can suspend your account.
terms.footer: These rules apply while you use KaGawa.
terms.s1: Be honest. Fake names, fake IDs, or fake jobs = ban.
terms.s2: Keep job chat and Bayad Code flow inside KaGawa. Labor cash is between customer and worker.
terms.s3: No harassment, threats, or illegal requests. Report serious problems in-app — and to authorities if it is a crime.
terms.s4: Ratings must be fair. Fake reviews or revenge ratings can be removed.
terms.s5: KaGawa is only a booking bridge (marketplace). We are not the employer, insurer, or guarantor of any worker or customer.
terms.s6: Cash for labor/materials stays between customer ↔ worker. KaGawa does not hold that money.
terms.s7: KaGawa is not liable for theft, damage, injury, poor workmanship, or other misconduct by a user. You deal with that person (and the police if needed).
terms.s8: For crime (theft, assault, threats): call / go to the police or barangay first. An in-app report is not a blotter — it only helps us ban accounts.
terms.s9: We may share a user’s verified identity and contact details with the other party and with lawful authorities when needed for safety or a crime report.
terms.c1: Book only real home jobs you will be present for (or authorize someone at home).
terms.c2: Share the Bayad Code only after you are satisfied and have paid the worker in cash.
terms.c3: Secure valuables (cash, jewelry, gadgets, documents) before a worker arrives. That is your responsibility.
terms.c4: Treat workers with respect. Provide safe access to the work area.
terms.c5: Cancel early if plans change. Repeated no-shows may limit booking.
terms.c6: Photos/notes you upload should be about the job — not other people’s private data.
terms.c7: Service quality disputes: use job chat / Report to KaGawa. We may pause accounts using chat + job timeline — we do not refund labor cash.
terms.c8: If a worker steals or commits a crime: report to police / barangay. Use Call/SMS and the worker’s verified ID details they already shared with you via KaGawa.
terms.c9: By booking, you accept that KaGawa only connects you — any claim for loss or misconduct is against the worker (or customer), not against KaGawa as insurer.
terms.w1: Go Online only when you can take jobs. Accept only work you can do safely.
terms.w2: Your ID must be yours. Clearances you upload must be valid and not forged.
terms.w3: Do not pressure customers to move the whole job off-app to hide misconduct.
terms.w4: Collect cash only for agreed labor + materials. Enter the Bayad Code to complete.
terms.w5: Set honest rates (₱/hr or ₱/day). No bait pricing then sudden large upsells without consent.
terms.w6: Never enter a home if you feel unsafe — cancel and Report to KaGawa. Call police if threatened.
terms.w7: Stealing, damage, or no-shows after accept can mean permanent removal — and criminal / civil cases by the customer, not by KaGawa as their lawyer.
terms.w8: You are an independent worker. Customers (and authorities) may contact you directly using the phone/ID you verified.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.headline: What we use — short version
privacy.sub: We keep this short on purpose.
privacy.p1: We use your name, phone, address, and job details to run bookings.
privacy.p2: ID / selfie uploads are for safety checks and account verification.
privacy.p3: Location (if you share GPS) is used to match nearby jobs.
privacy.p4: Chat is job-scoped. We may review flagged messages (off-app payment talk, etc.).
privacy.p5: Labor cash is P2P — KaGawa does not process that payment.
privacy.p6: If there is a crime report or lawful request, we may share identity and contact info with the other party and with police / barangay so they can pursue the person directly.

safety.bridgeBody: We connect customers and independent workers. We are not their employer, insurer, or cash holder. Misconduct is between those two people.
safety.valuables: Keep cash, jewelry, gadgets, and important documents secured. Looking after valuables is the customer’s responsibility.
safety.crime: Theft, assault, or threats → call {number} and report to police / barangay first. Use the worker’s name, phone, and verified ID from this app. In-app Report only helps us ban accounts — it is not a police case.
safety.bookAck: I understand KaGawa is only a booking bridge with no support hotline. I will secure valuables. For theft or danger I will call {number}; KaGawa is not liable for worker misconduct.
safety.noSupport: KaGawa has no customer-support hotline. If you are in danger or something was stolen, call {number} now. Use the person’s name, phone, and verified ID from this booking. Then send an in-app report so we can ban the account. We do not investigate crimes and we do not pay claims.

fee.bodyAutomated: Pay KaGawa via QR. You get a receipt + reference as proof. Worker cannot collect this fee in cash.

fee.qrStep3: Copy the txn / ref no. from your receipt and paste below
fee.unpaidBody: Pay the flat KaGawa fee in-app so we receive it — not via cash to the worker.
fee.simBody: Simulation only. 4242 4242 4242 4242 is approved. Any other number is declined. Production uses PayMongo and rejects this card.
fee.simRequired: Pay the test card before booking.

guide.title: How it works
guide.whatBody: An on-demand marketplace for home services — like Grab/Uber, but the “ride” is a plumber, on-call cleaner, electrician, or other hourly worker (not live-in).
guide.twoCustomer: Customer — book help, pick a worker, pay cash, share the Bayad Code.
guide.twoWorker: Worker — go Online, set your rates, accept jobs, finish with the code.
guide.twoPwa: Use it in your phone browser, or add KaGawa to your Home Screen so it opens like a normal app.
guide.payBody: Labor + materials: cash on completion. No booking fee on the customer.
guide.pay1: Job starts → customer sees a 4-digit Bayad Code.
guide.pay2: Finish the work. Customer pays cash for labor + materials.
guide.pay3: Customer shares the code only after they're satisfied and have paid cash.
guide.pay4: Worker enters the code → job completed. Both sides have an audit trail.
guide.safeCustomer: Customer: don't share the code until work is done / worth it / paid. Worker can't mark complete without it.
guide.safeWorker: Worker: don't leave until you get the code — proof the work was accepted and paid.
guide.safeExtra: Ratings + verified badges + call button. (Production: ID checks, disputes.)
guide.earnTitle: How does the app owner earn?
guide.earnIntro: Labor cash is 100% between customer and worker. KaGawa earns outside that handshake:
guide.earnFee: No booking fee and no cut on the job itself.
guide.earnBoost: Workers set their own ₱/hr or ₱/day — customers compare and pick.
guide.earnCut: Priority Online — workers optionally pay later for first look at new jobs.
guide.earnLater: Also like other apps: featured listings, supplier ads, materials partners, condo/B2B contracts.
guide.signal1: Worker goes Online + sets skills + city/barangay.
guide.signal2: New booking → match by service + city → shows in Incoming feed.
guide.signal3: Your phone can vibrate / ping when a new job comes in.
guide.signal4: Accept → status updates (en route → start → complete with code).
guide.servicesBody: Cleaning, plumbing, electrical, appliances, carpentry, painting, aircon, pest control, laundry, gardening, errands, general handyman — all hourly on demand.

admin.title: KaGawa Admin
admin.loginHint: Admin accounts are separate from customers and workers. Username and password only. This page is not in the app nav.
admin.needEnv: Set ADMIN_JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_USERNAME, and ADMIN_PASSWORD (8+ characters). Run the admin_accounts migration and set SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY so the password lives in its own table.
admin.reportsHint: In-app reports. Pause or ban only. KaGawa does not close cases or pay claims.
admin.customersHint: People who book. Page size 20. Search name or phone.
admin.workersHint: Independent workers. Page size 20. Search name or phone.
admin.needServiceRole: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is not set. This directory is using the publishable key. Set the service-role key before a public launch.
admin.notEmployer: KaGawa is not the employer and does not send “our” worker. The customer chose them. Admin can pause or ban. There is no case-closed or compensation state.
admin.policeFirst: This is not a blotter. File with the police or barangay first. Then copy this note. KaGawa only pauses or bans the account.
admin.kycBody: Didit keeps the ID photo. KaGawa stores only this reference so a complainant or the police can cite it. No second copy of the ID image is kept here.
admin.banReason: Why this ban (crime report, unsafe, theft…)
admin.banHint: Ban blocks new bookings and going online. Pause is temporary. Neither one investigates the report or pays a claim.

report.title: Report a problem
report.aboutGeneric: Goes to the KaGawa admin for a pause or ban. This is not a support hotline.
report.notEmployer: KaGawa is not the employer and does not send “our” worker. The customer chose them.
report.noHotline: There is no support hotline. If you are in danger or this is a crime, call {number}, then file with the police. This form only asks KaGawa to pause or ban the account.
report.detailsPlaceholder: What happened? Include times if you can.
report.toAdmin: Goes to KaGawa admin (ban / pause) — not a police blotter.
report.authoritiesBody: KaGawa is only a bridge. For theft or other crimes, file with police / barangay. Use Call/SMS and the person’s verified name + ID from this booking.
report.crimeFirst: This in-app report will not replace a police report. File with authorities, then send us details so we can ban the account.
report.idHelp: We keep verified ID + phone so you (and lawful authorities) can pursue the person directly — KaGawa does not pay claims or act as their lawyer.
report.beforePayBody: If something is wrong, call {number}, or send a report with a photo. A short complaint with no picture is not accepted.
report.needDetails: Write what happened in a few sentences. A one-line complaint is not enough.
report.evidenceHint: Photo of what happened — damage, the place, or the message. Not a government ID. Required.
report.evidenceType: Use a JPEG, PNG, or WebP photo.
report.evidenceSize: That photo is too large. Take a smaller one.
